fns.desc: wpa_ft_process_rdie checks only 'end - pos < sizeof(*rdie)' before writing 2 header bytes (EID+Length) plus sizeof(*rdie) of struct data (2424-2430) - the bounds check is short by 2 bytes per call. wpa_ft_process_ric invokes this once per attacker-controlled RIC subelement in an FT Reassociation Request, so enough small subelements can cumulatively overrun the fixed +200-byte margin computed in wpa_sm_write_assoc_resp_ies's buflen. Bounded/narrow but a real off-by-2 bounds-check bug on wire-derived-count input.
